**📅 August 31, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bearish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Fed Chair Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech triggered a hawkish repricing, with rate-hike odds surging to ~60% and front-end Treasury yields spiking
• AI mega-caps (Nvidia, Microsoft) are propping up headline indexes while broad market breadth deteriorates and small-cap weakness spreads
• Escalating Iran war tensions (U.S. strikes, Hormuz risks) and expanding Trump trade wars (Canada, China, semiconductors) are driving oil and food inflation higher

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• September seasonal volatility converging with a Fed regime change and potential energy/grain supply shocks
• Extreme index concentration creates fragility if AI momentum breaks or rates spike further

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
A hawkish Fed pivot, escalating Iran supply risks, and widening trade wars are overwhelming narrow AI-led equity gains and setting up a volatile September regime shift.
